hypothesis: Shear/dilation structure-tensor coherence of geodetic strain-rate bands (07_geod_shearrate x 08_geod_dilaterate) as an off-catalogue blind step-over / dilatational-jog fault prior.
physical_signature: Linear structural fabric (high structure-tensor coherence) of the shear-rate/dilation-rate gradient fields at concealed fault step-overs and jogs; no continuous scarp required.
why_off_catalogue: Step-overs and jogs of mapped segments are unmapped faults outside the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue; dots land beyond the 200 m catalogue-flank exclusion, so they are creditable DTI mass rather than masked mass.
differs_from_repo: Bands 07/08 are unused in any emission pipeline in this repo; no structure-tensor pair of strain-rate channels exists anywhere in the stack. ATVR-36 uses gravity/magnetic tilt-THDR, relief-deconfounded slope/TC, RTP troughs, conductivity, basement flexure and regime probabilities — none of them strain-rate coherence.
named_non_fault_mimic: Erosional drainage density and alluvial-fan distributary channels also form coherent linear fabric; controlled by off-catalogue eligibility (d_cat > 2 px) and the 300 m kernel DTI.
expected_dti_improvement: +0.005 to +0.015 over a single-channel baseline (unverified until this run)
